finish.summary: Single-cell hexagonal storage box: full hex base with full-depth bin interior and full top cover as lid. Covers are magnetic by default - attempted to enable magnets confirmed they are already fitted, so lid is magnetically retained. Caps applied to all open side faces and joints locked.
